paper.title: Markov logic networks
paper.section: Table 1 / Fig. 1 — smoking causes cancer (w=1.5-style weighted implication) and friends have similar smoking habits, grounded for two constants
paper.claim: Ground MLN for {anna, bob} with evidence smokes(anna) and friends(anna,bob): the MAP state satisfies every ground clause (cost 0) and entails smokes(bob), cancer(anna), cancer(bob).

input.intent: MAP inference on the smokes/friends MLN
